items.title: The companies emerging as new leaders in this renewed AI rally
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre examines the comeback seen across the semiconductor landscape over the past five trading days, while also analyzing which companies are emerging as leaders in the renewed AI rally.

items.title: The companies defying macro uncertainty and raising guidance: AlphaCheck

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Scores Record As SpaceX Craters; SharkNinja Soars
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rises Wednesday with word on a Strait of Hormuz deal. AMD stock and SpaceX fall.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: SpaceX, AMD, Disney
items.summary: ↘️ Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX): Elon Musk’s space company said its capital expenditures hit $18.4 billion in its most recent quarter. Shares fell about 13%. ↘️ Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): The chip maker's stock dropped 6% following Musk's comments that SpaceX would no longer buy AMD chips.

items.title: Arista Stock Jumps 5.2% as AI Networking Revenue Crushes Forecasts
items.summary: Arista's revenue grew 38% as hyperscalers expanded the high-speed networks connecting increasingly powerful AI infrastructure.

items.title: Arista Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates on Solid Revenue Growth
items.summary: ANET tops Q2 estimates as AI, cloud and enterprise networking demand fuel 37.7% revenue growth, with Q3 revenues projected at about $3.3 billion.

items.title: ANET Q2 Earnings Call Centers on Supply Gains and 2026 Raise
items.summary: Arista lifts its 2026 revenue outlook to $12.6B for a third time as supply gains unlock shipments across AI, data center, campus and routing.
